learning_objective: 🌍 Understand how dance is not just entertainment, but a mirror reflecting the geography, traditions, and community spirit of a people!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: लोक नृत्य (आम लोगों का पारंपरिक नृत्य जो त्योहारों या फसल कटने पर किया जाता है)
शास्त्रीय नृत्य (कठोर नियमों और व्याकरण पर आधारित प्राचीन नृत्य शैली)
अनुष्ठान / धार्मिक संस्कार (पूजा या परंपरा का हिस्सा)
विरासत (पूर्वजों से मिली संस्कृति, कला और परंपराएं)
समुदाय (एक साथ रहने और समान संस्कृति साझा करने वाले लोग)

main_concepts.concept_title: 🌾 Folk Dance: The Pulse of the People
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Folk dances (like Bhangra, Garba, or Bihu) are born from the daily lives of common people. They celebrate seasons, harvests, and weddings. They are spontaneous, energetic, and involve the whole community dancing together in circles or lines.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🏛️ Classical Dance: The Rule of the Texts
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Classical dances (like Bharatanatyam, Odissi, or Kathak) originated in temples or royal courts. They require years of rigorous training, follow strict ancient rules (like the Natyashastra), and focus on spiritual devotion and perfection.

Where people live changes how they dance. In the flat, fertile plains of Punjab, Bhangra is energetic with high jumps. In the graceful landscapes of the Northeast, Manipuri uses soft, swaying, fluid movements.
In many cultures, dance is a way to speak to the gods. Ritual dances are performed to bring rain, cure diseases, or ensure a good harvest. They are sacred practices, not just stage performances.

Dance acts as a living museum. Traditional clothes, local instruments, ancient languages in the songs, and mythological stories are passed down from generation to generation through these dances, preserving cultural identity.

fun_activity.title: 🌍 Match the State!
fun_activity.instructions: India’s diversity is seen in its dance! Can you match the dance to the state without looking it up? 1. Garba, 2. Lavani, 3. Bhangra, 4. Odissi. (Answers: 1. Gujarat, 2. Maharashtra, 3. Punjab, 4. Odisha).

exam_tips: 📌 A 5-mark question comparing Folk Dance (spontaneous, community, simple steps) and Classical Dance (rigorous training, solo/stage focus, complex rules) is highly likely.
📌 Give examples of how geography impacts dance styles (e.g., coastal vs. mountainous regions).
📌 Explain how dance fosters 'Community Cohesion'—it brings people of all ages together to celebrate shared values and festivals.
quick_recap: ⭐ Folk dances are generally performed in groups and circles, emphasizing equality and community participation.
⭐ Eight dance forms are recognized as 'Classical' in India by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
⭐ Tribal and folk dances often use everyday objects like sticks, pots, or swords as props.
